about: Macdonald is a rural municipality immediately southwest of Winnipeg, Manitoba—not the City of Winnipeg, and not other Canadian places named Macdonald. Hamlets such as Sanford, La Salle, Oak Bluff, Starbuck, and Domain sit among Red River Valley farmland. About 8,000 people live in Macdonald RM.
